findings.issue: Piel imperfect 3ms יְגַלֵּחַ keeps the masculine subject of the hithpael; וְאֶת marks הַנֶּתֶק as its object. Spanish makes el neteq the subject of afeitará and leaves that verb with no object.
הַנֶּתֶק (H5424) is a common noun, not a proper name. neteq dumps the lemma untranslated.
שֵׁנִית is a feminine singular ordinal and does not agree with masculine plural יָמִים, so it marks a second time. Bare segunda keeps the ordinal but does not clearly mark that second occasion.

notes: se afeitará matches the hithpael 3ms; encerrará el sacerdote el neteq siete días matches the hiphil, the priest, the object, and seven days.
